§6Bricked Furnace§f

§aNot just a furnace. It's a furnace that loves construction materials.§f

The §bBricked Furnace§f smelts sand and cobblestone at §e2× speed§f, and clay or fireclay at §e4× speed§f. It also produces ashes from fuel, which you'll want to collect.

Craft it at a table from bricks and stone. One of the cheapest upgrades you can make, and it pays for itself immediately if you're building blast furnaces.

Other furnace options: §bIron Furnace§f (20% faster, supports speed upgrades), §bSteel Furnace§f (TU-powered, bonus output), §bElectric Furnace§f (clean automation, needs power).

§ePS:§f This is the best furnace for bulk firebrick production. The 4× speed on fireclay is unmatched.
